thread:
Maya (Design): quick copy nit — the session timeout banner shows a single button labeled `Extend` and a tooltip that says `Extend session`. Feels vague to me, esp for screen readers. can we make this clearer? :thinking:
Sam (Product): agree, I got a user question yesterday — they didn't know how long it would extend for. is the backend returning duration?
Ravi (Eng): backend returns 30m for the default flow. the button is implementation-agnostic tho. i think adding duration in copy makes sense.
Jordan (Accessibility): a11y note: visible text should be short, but aria-label can include the duration. tooltips should not be the only place we convey critical info; tooltips aren't reliably exposed to keyboard/screen reader users.
Maya (Design): proposal for CTA wording: `Keep me signed in` (primary) and secondary `Sign out now`. tooltip text: `Extend your session by 30 minutes` — but aria-label on the CTA should be `Keep me signed in for 30 minutes`.
Sam (Product): short vs long: curious whether `Stay signed in` is better than `Keep me signed in` (for translation conciseness). anyone have strong preference?
Ravi (Eng): both fine. prefer `Keep me signed in` for tone. implementation detail — i18n keys I'd add: `session_banner.cta_keep` and `session_banner.cta_signout`.
Jordan (Accessibility): suggested aria sample:
```html
<button aria-label="Keep me signed in for 30 minutes">Keep me signed in</button>
```
And make sure the banner update triggers a live region announcement or role=alert when it appears so AT users know a session is expiring.
Maya (Design): +1 on role=alert. also, consistency: other banners show durations as `in 5 minutes` vs `for 30 minutes` — we should standardize phrasing across console. I'll run a quick audit. :memo:
Ravi (Eng): quick follow-up — when extend fails right now we show `Could not extend session`. Can we make that more actionable?
Jordan (Accessibility): yes — propose `We couldn't extend your session. Sign in again to continue.` That gives next-step. also add error telemetry key for the flow.
Sam (Product): sounds good. can we keep the tooltip optional for mobile? tooltips are awkward on touch. if we include duration in the CTA aria-label and the banner copy, we can avoid needing mobile tooltips.
Maya (Design): action items: 1) copy update in Figma (Maya) 2) update i18n keys and aria patterns (Ravi) 3) a11y checklist changes: role=alert & error wording (Jordan) 4) QA note: mobile no-tooltip fallback (Sam). I'll push a small copy PR and ping y'all.
Ravi (Eng): i'll update the component and add unit test for aria-label and for the error string. will reference i18n keys in the PR.
Sam (Product): thanks — please @mention me when PR is ready so I can validate messaging with support transcripts.
Maya (Design): draft pushed to figma -> https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/session-banner-copy (mock) — sending PR after a quick review. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: reminder: update storybook snapshot when PR lands.
Jordan (Accessibility): tiny nit for screen readers: avoid `Extend` as the only label. it's ambiguous out of context. otherwise looks good.
Maya (Design): cool — i’ll iterate and post final copy here once i've reconciled translations. thanks team! :raised_hands:
